summary: Register GigaChat (Sber) as a third ai-family provider for the Task-122 AI provider account capability, performing a per-call OAuth exchange before completion.

impacts.evidence: GigaChat reuses the Task-122 ai_provider_accounts table and secret binding; it adds no tenant persistence of its own.
The only tenant text that leaves TORGNEXA through this provider is the caller-assembled analytics prompt at analyze-call time; the exchanged OAuth token is used once and never persisted.
GigaChat is reached through the existing Task-122 /settings/ai-providers:analyze operation; no new public operation is added.
No EventBus schema is published or consumed.
Adds the gigachat provider under the existing ai family/ai.completion.generate capability; dispatch by provider id is confined to internal/platform/builtinruntime.
No schema change; GigaChat reuses the ai_provider_accounts table introduced by Task-122.

Provider code has no direct network authority; both the OAuth exchange and the completion call are host-mediated through builtinruntime's DNS-pinned, public-IP-only transport. Credential bytes are read only inside a host-owned UseSecret callback. GigaChat's endpoints require the Russian Trusted Root CA in the host transport's trust store; this connector never disables certificate verification to work around a missing CA.
Reuses the Task-122 ai.analyze / settings.ai_providers.* capability gates unchanged.
Reuses the Task-122 audit entries unchanged.
This capability performs no remote-state synchronization.
Outbound calls use a host-injected transport to two fixed hosts (ngw.devices.sberbank.ru for OAuth, gigachat.devices.sberbank.ru for completion); no inbound webhook surface is added.
Remote non-2xx responses at either stage and empty/malformed completions normalize to a bounded error; the manifest's rate_limit/retry policy bounds concurrency and backoff.
Disabling the account row immediately stops further GigaChat analyze calls; no other component depends on this provider.

Package tests cover the two-request OAuth-then-completion sequence and header shapes; the canonical Task-064 conformance suite passes all thirteen checks (docs/connectors/gigachat/conformance-report.json), including sandbox_isolation verified under a privileged Linux runner.
